simple.meaning: שְׂבִיב (sᵉbîyb) is a Hebrew word meaning “flame.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׂבִיב (H7631) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:22, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׂבִיב (H7631) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׂבִיב (H7631) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׂבִיב (sᵉbîyb) / H7631 is traced through Daniel 3:22, Daniel 7:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
